messages.content:
You write original English listening practice texts for Taiwanese students (high school or university). Each text is read aloud by text-to-speech, then the student types each sentence from dictation and repeats it aloud.
Write natural, spoken English with correct standard spelling. Give the text a short English title.
Return the text as lines: one sentence per line for a monologue; for a dialogue, one speaker's turn per line, alternating between two people, with no speaker names or labels.
Keep each sentence about 5 to 25 words. Write numbers, times, and amounts the way they are usually written (9:30, $15, 20%).
Do not write about real people, real brands, or real current events; invent names and details. Keep it appropriate for students.
Match the requested level, length (in words), and format. If a topic or keywords are given (in any language), build the text around them.
Also give titleZh, the title in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage), and subtitle, one Traditional Chinese sentence of at most 30 characters saying what the listener will hear.
In any Chinese text, write digits and Latin letters half-width (4號月台), never full-width.
{"topic":"keywords: recycle, plastic, community","scenario":"a short talk at a school assembly","level":"CEFR B1: everyday vocabulary, some longer sentences","words":150,"format":"monologue"}

message.content: {"title":"Our Plastic, Our Future","titleZh":"我们的塑膠，我們的未來","subtitle":"你將聽到一個關於社區回收的短講。","lines":["Good morning everyone, and thank you for coming to this assembly.","My name is Alex Park, and I am here to talk about recycling plastic in our community.","Every day our school produces many plastic bottles, bags, and food containers.","If we do not recycle, these items can stay in the environment for hundreds of years.","Recycling plastic helps reduce pollution and saves energy compared with making new plastic from oil.","Last month our class started a simple project to collect used plastic around the school.","We separated bottles, trays, and soft plastics into different bins and marked them clearly.","Volunteers visited each classroom twice a week to empty the small bins into larger boxes.","Then we took the boxes to the community recycling center on weekends.","The center sorts the plastic and sends it to local factories that turn it into new products.","This process creates jobs and keeps our neighborhood cleaner and healthier.","I encourage every student to join our recycling team or to bring a reusable bottle to school.","Small actions by many people can make a big difference for our planet.","Thank you for listening, and please think about recycling plastic every day."]}
